message.content:
### 1. Overall Layout  
The hero section uses a **2-column layout** with a **full-width background** (light mint green) that spans the entire viewport. The left column occupies approximately 45% of the width, while the right column takes up 55%, creating a balanced split between text/content and visual imagery. The layout is vertically centered, with the left side containing text and a search bar, and the right side featuring a grid of images.  


### 2. Left Side Content  
The left column is structured with a clear hierarchy of text and a search bar:  
- **Heading Text**:  
  - Primary heading: *"More Than 174,000 Business Listings"* (red, bold, large font, top-aligned).  
  - Secondary heading: *"Dream Explore Discover"* (dark brown/black, extra-bold, larger than the primary heading, centered below the first line).  
- **Description**: A paragraph of gray text: *"Discover amazing places near you in just a few clicks. Browse top listings and connect with trusted local businesses every day."* (smaller font, centered below the headings).  
- **Search Bar**: A white rectangular container with rounded corners (padding: ~1rem) containing:  
  - Two dropdown fields:  
    - *"Category"* (label: gray, small font) with a dropdown menu labeled *"Select Category"* (light gray input, rounded corners, right-aligned dropdown arrow).  
    - *"Location"* (label: gray, small font) with a dropdown menu labeled *"Select Location"* (light gray input, rounded corners, right-aligned dropdown arrow + a small magnifying glass icon).  
  - A black button with white text: *"Search"* (rounded corners, padding: ~0.75rem 1.5rem, left-aligned magnifying glass icon).  
- **Popular Categories**: A row of gray text labels with icons: *"Popular:"* (bold) followed by *"Automotive"* (car icon), *"Spas & Massages"* (hands icon), *"Travel & Tourism"* (plane icon), *"Food & Dining"* (utensils icon) (small font, spaced evenly).  


### 3. Right Side Content  
The right column features a **grid of 4 images** (2x2 layout) with a large red play button overlay on the top-left image:  
- **Top-left image**: A modern apartment building (realistic photo, full width of its grid cell).  
- **Top-right image**: A yellow sports car (realistic photo, full width of its grid cell).  
- **Bottom-left image**: A laptop with a colorful screen (realistic photo, full width of its grid cell).  
- **Bottom-right image**: Three pets (dog, bulldog, cat) (realistic photo, full width of its grid cell).  
- **Play Button**: A circular red button (diameter: ~3rem) with a white play icon, centered over the apartment building image.  


### 4. Color Scheme  
- **Background**: Light mint green (#e6f7f0 or similar).  
- **Text**:  
  - Primary heading: Red (#ff3333 or similar).  
  - Secondary heading: Dark brown/black (#2d2d2d or similar).  
  - Description: Gray (#666666 or similar).  
  - Popular categories: Gray (#888888 or similar).  
- **Search Bar**: White background with light gray inputs.  
- **Button**: Black (#000000 or similar) with white text.  
- **Play Button**: Bright red (#ff0000 or similar) with white icon.  


### 5. Search Bar Design  
- **Container**: White, rounded corners (radius: ~0.5rem), padding: ~1rem.  
- **Fields**:  
  - Two dropdowns: Light gray background, rounded corners (radius: ~0.25rem), padding: ~0.5rem, width: ~45% each (side by side).  
  - Dropdown arrows: Gray, right-aligned.  
- **Button**: Black background, white text, rounded corners (radius: ~0.25rem), padding: ~0.75rem 1.5rem, left-aligned magnifying glass icon.  


### 6. Badges or Labels  
No explicit badges/labels are visible, but the "Popular:" section acts as a label for the category icons.  


### 7. Exact Text Content  
- Primary heading: *"More Than 174,000 Business Listings"*  
- Secondary heading: *"Dream Explore Discover"*  
- Description: *"Discover amazing places near you in just a few clicks. Browse top listings and connect with trusted local businesses every day."*  
- Search bar labels: *"Category"*, *"Location"*, *"Select Category"*, *"Select Location"*, *"Search"*  
- Popular categories: *"Popular:"*, *"Automotive"*, *"Spas & Massages"*, *"Travel & Tourism"*, *"Food & Dining"*  


### Visual Details  
- **Spacing**: Generous padding between elements (e.g., 2rem between headings and description, 1rem between search bar fields).  
- **Icons**: Simple, flat design (car, hands, plane, utensils for popular categories; magnifying glass for search button).  
- **Images**: High-resolution, realistic photos with no borders, filling their grid cells.  
- **Play Button**: Centered over the apartment image, with a white play icon (triangle) inside a red circle.
